items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: the theme is the movie “Tom Jones”

ctx.x: But along those lines I’ll try a question that hardly ever works also, and that is, have you ever, do you recall just a terrible gig or series of gigs that you just couldn’t believe you were involved in?

Well there’s, sure. I remember one night I had booked a gig with a group in town, a guy in town here who I’d worked for doing a lot of trade shows. And he said, “You have to go get fitted for a costume.” So I went down to this place where they have theatrical costumes and I went and got fitted for the costume.
